1.consolidated_definition: Pez marino de hasta 40 cm de longitud, de boca pequeña y ojos grandes, con escamas ligeras de color castaño y bandas longitudinales en el tronco y las aletas, con una espina dura, puntiaguda y cortante a cada lado de la cola, que mueve a voluntad. Acanthuridae Acanthurus chirurgus.
1.en_consolidated_definition: Marine fish reaching up to 40 cm in length, with a small mouth and large eyes, featuring light brown scales and longitudinal bands on the body and fins, as well as a hard, pointed, and cutting spine at each side of the tail, which can be moved at will. Acanthuridae Acanthurus chirurgus.
